# EU legal acts (Regulation / Directive / Decision), four input forms:
#   canonical  EU Regulation 1227/2011, EU Directive 2016/680
#   long (OJ)  Regulation (EU) No 1227/2011, Directive 2010/75/EU
#   CELEX      CELEX 32011R1227, CELEX:32011R1227, 32011R1227
#   ELI        http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2011/1227/oj
# The canonical and long forms capture the two numbers as `first` and
# `second`: which one is the year is not derivable from the grammar
# (`Regulation (EC) No 2003/2003`), so the Ruby builder decides; an
# optional `No` (also in the canonical form, where the renderer prints it
# only to tell two readings apart) marks <number>/<year>. CELEX and ELI fix
# the order, so they capture `year` and `number` directly. The bracketed
# and the suffixed family are separate captures, so the builder can reject
# a conflict (`Regulation (EU) No 1227/2011/EC`).

grammar PubidEu version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  type_word = ("Regulation" / "Directive" / "Decision") as type_word
  family = ("Euratom" / "CFSP" / "EEC" / "EC" / "EU") as family
  family_suffix = ("Euratom" / "CFSP" / "EEC" / "EC" / "EU") as family_suffix
  first = (1*digit) as first
  second = (1*digit) as second
  canonical = ("EU") as prefix " " type_word [(" No") as no] " " first "/" second
  long = type_word [" (" family ")"] [(" No") as no] " " first "/" second ["/" family_suffix]
  celex_letter = ("R" / "L" / "D") as celex_letter
  celex = ["CELEX" (" " / ": " / ":")] "3" (4digit) as year celex_letter (1*digit) as number
  eli_type = ("reg" / "dir" / "dec") as eli_type
  eli = "http" ["s"] "://data.europa.eu/eli/" eli_type "/" (4digit) as year "/" (1*digit) as number ["/oj"]
  identifier = canonical / long / celex / eli
  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    prefix -> prefix (string)
    type_word -> type_word (string)
    family -> family (string)
    family_suffix -> family_suffix (string)
    no -> no (string)
    first -> first (string)
    second -> second (string)
    celex_letter -> celex_letter (string)
    eli_type -> eli_type (string)
    year -> year (string)
    number -> number (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "EU Regulation 1227/2011"
    accept "EU Directive 2016/680"
    accept "Regulation (EU) No 1227/2011"
    accept "Directive 2010/75/EU"
    accept "CELEX 32011R1227"
    accept "CELEX: 32011R1227"
    accept "EU Regulation No 2015/2014"
    accept "32016L0680"
    accept "http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2011/1227/oj"
    reject "nonsense"
    reject "EU Regulation 1227"
    example "EU Regulation 1227/2011" { prefix: "EU", type_word: "Regulation", first: "1227", second: "2011" }
    example "Regulation (EU) No 1227/2011" { type_word: "Regulation", family: "EU", no: " No", first: "1227", second: "2011" }
    example "Directive 2010/75/EU" { type_word: "Directive", first: "2010", second: "75", family_suffix: "EU" }
    example "EU Regulation No 2015/2014" { prefix: "EU", type_word: "Regulation", no: " No", first: "2015", second: "2014" }
    example "CELEX 32016R0679" { year: "2016", celex_letter: "R", number: "0679" }
    example "http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2016/680/oj" { eli_type: "dir", year: "2016", number: "680" }
  }
}
